name: conduit-flow
description: Read your company's accounts, balances, transactions, contacts and quotes in Conduit Flow, and draft payouts that a person approves in Flow.

interface.longDescription:
Conduit Flow is the treasury console for companies that move money with Conduit. This plugin lets ChatGPT work with your company's Flow data, as you, within your own Flow permissions.

Read: companies, accounts and live balances, transactions, contacts, requests for information from Conduit's compliance team, and indicative quotes.

Draft: ChatGPT can draft a payout to an approved contact, or propose a new contact. A draft never moves money. A person in your company must approve it in Flow, under your company's approval rules, before anything is sent. ChatGPT cannot approve, release, send or sign.

Access is off until Conduit turns it on for your company. Every read and draft is recorded in your company's audit trail.
defaultPrompt: What are our balances across all accounts right now?
Show the last 10 transactions and flag any that failed.
Draft a 100 USDC intercompany payout to our own wallet contact.

positive.description: List the companies the signed-in user can use
positive.prompt: Which companies can I see in Conduit Flow?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test company by name. No other company appears.

positive.prompt: What are the balances of each account in my company?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each account and wallet with its asset balances. Account numbers are masked.
Lists recent transactions with type, status, amounts and dates. No memos or document links.

positive.prompt: How much USDC on Base would I get for 100 USD?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an indicative rate, spread, fees and expiry. States that no order is created.

positive.description: Draft a payout that a person must approve
positive.prompt: Draft a 0.10 USDC intercompany payout from my Ethereum wallet to the contact Canco.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a draft with status awaiting_human_approval and a link to approve it in Flow. No money moves.

negative.prompt: Send 100 USDC to Canco right now and confirm it was paid.
Approve my pending payout draft so it goes out.

negative.description: Another company's data is not reachable
negative.prompt: Show me the balances of a company I am not a member of.

publication.release_notes: Available in every country ChatGPT supports.
